morning: Set up your daily workspace ritual: desk, drink, open Procreate. No pressure to create — just show up.
evening: Write down your 5 hero design ideas in a notes app or sketchbook. Brain dump everything.
win: You sat down. That's it. Day 1 win.

morning: Sketch your first design idea loosely — no linework, no pressure. Just shapes.
evening: Clean up one sketch or trace it in Procreate. Export as PNG even if it's rough.

morning: Research 3 sticker shops you love. Screenshot what draws you in.
evening: Write down: what makes YOUR style different from those 3 shops?
win: You know what sets you apart.

morning: Sketch design idea #2. Go fast, go messy.
evening: Digitize it roughly in Procreate. Doesn't have to be perfect.

morning: Write your shop name, tagline, and 3 words that describe your vibe.
evening: Pick your hero product: die-cut stickers, sheet, or pack. Know your format.
win: Your brand has a name and a format.

morning: Batch day: set up your Procreate canvas template for stickers (300dpi, correct size).
evening: Finish designs 1 and 2 fully — clean lines, filled colours.
content: Film your workspace setup. Post a 'day 1 of my sticker journey' reel or TikTok.
win: You have a template and 2 finished designs.

morning: Weekly review: what did you finish? What did you avoid? Write 3 sentences.
evening: Plan week 2: write out your 5 designs, which 3 you'll finish this week.
win: You planned. That's the whole win.

morning: Sketch design idea #3 from your list.
evening: Digitize design #3. Get it to a clean sketch stage.

morning: Review your 2 finished designs. Do they feel cohesive?
evening: Add details, adjust colours — make them feel like a matching set.
win: Your designs talk to each other.

morning: Sketch design #4.
evening: Start coloring design #4.
win: Halfway to your first batch of 5.

morning: Finish design #4. Export clean PNG.
evening: Start design #5.

morning: Finish design #5. Export.
evening: Line up all 5 designs and screenshot them together. You have a collection.

morning: Batch: set up your shop — Etsy or Ko-fi shop shell. Name, banner placeholder, bio.
evening: Upload your first listing (design #1 or #2). Just get it live, even draft mode.
content: Post a 'first listing is almost up!' story with your design.

morning: Weekly review. What got hard this week? Write about it honestly.
evening: Plan week 3: set a goal of getting 5 listings live.

morning: Prep listing #2 — write the title, description, and tags.
evening: Upload listing #2 to your shop.

morning: Prep listing #3.
evening: Upload listing #3.

morning: Create a simple mockup for 1 design using Canva or a free mockup site.
evening: Prep listing #4 with mockup image.

morning: Prep listing #5.
evening: Upload listing #5. Your shop is officially open.
content: Post a proper 'my shop is open' announcement.

morning: Research your hashtags and shop keywords.
evening: Update all 5 listings with better SEO tags.

morning: Batch day: sketch designs 6–8.
evening: Digitize and clean up design #6.
content: Post a process video or timelapse of you drawing.

morning: Weekly review. How do you feel about your shop?
evening: Write a short brand promise statement: 'byjessalyn exists to ___'
win: You know why you're building this.

morning: Finish and export design #7.
evening: Finish and export design #8.

morning: Sketch designs 9 and 10.
evening: Start digitizing design #9.

morning: Finish design #9.
evening: Finish design #10. You now have 10 designs.
content: Post a '10 designs done' milestone moment.

morning: Create mockups for designs 6–8.
evening: List designs 6–8 in your shop.

morning: List designs 9 and 10.
evening: Do a full shop audit: photos, descriptions, pricing. Fix anything off.

morning: Batch: create 3 more designs themed around your hero collection.
evening: Export and list at least 1 new design.
content: Post a shop tour video — short, casual, just show your listings.

morning: Phase 1 review. What worked? What do you want to do differently in Phase 2?
evening: Celebrate. Do something that feels like a reward — this is real now.
content: Post a Day 28 reflection — honest, warm, 'here's where I'm at'.
win: Phase 1 complete. You built something real.

morning: Plan your first content series. 3-5 posts with a through-line theme.
evening: Script post #1 of your series.

morning: Film or create content post #1.
evening: Edit and schedule post #1.
win: Day 30. You're still here. That's everything.

morning: Design a sticker sheet concept (4–6 stickers, themed).
evening: Sketch the full sheet layout.

morning: Begin digitizing sticker sheet stickers.
evening: Finish 2 of the stickers for the sheet.

morning: Finish 2 more stickers for the sheet.
evening: Assemble the sheet layout in Illustrator or Procreate.
content: Post a WIP of the sticker sheet.

morning: Batch: film content posts #2 and #3.
evening: Edit both videos and schedule them.

morning: Rest. Do something creative that isn't the business.
evening: Quick plan for week 6.
win: Rest is part of the plan.

morning: Finalize the sticker sheet. All stickers done, layout set.
evening: Export sticker sheet as final PNG and PDF.

morning: Create mockup for the sticker sheet.
evening: List the sticker sheet in your shop.
content: Announce the sticker sheet with a reel.

morning: Write your brand origin story — 1 paragraph, first person, honest.
evening: Turn it into a caption for an 'about me / brand story' post.
win: People know who you are now.

morning: Set up or refresh your Ko-fi page — about section, tiers, banner.
evening: Write a welcome post for Ko-fi.

morning: Design 3 new stickers for listings 16–18.
evening: Digitize and export all 3.

morning: Batch: list designs 16–18. Create mockups.
evening: Batch film content for next week.

morning: Check your shop analytics — what's getting clicks? What's not?
evening: Based on data: what do you make more of next week?

morning: Design stickers 19 and 20.
evening: Finish, export, list them. You have 20 listings.

morning: Plan your first 'drop' — a themed collection of 3–5 new designs releasing together.
evening: Sketch the drop concept.
content: Tease the drop — vague but exciting.

morning: Day 45. You're halfway. Sit with that for a second.
evening: Write a reflection: what surprised you most about these first 45 days?
content: Post your Day 45 check-in — honest, warm.

morning: Design drop piece #1.
evening: Design drop piece #2.

morning: Design drop piece #3.
evening: Assemble all drop pieces. Do they feel cohesive?

morning: Batch: create all mockups for the drop.
evening: Schedule drop listings to go live on drop day.
content: Build hype — post a 'something's coming' reel.

morning: Rest + plan week 8. What needs to happen for a great drop?
evening: Write a launch email or Ko-fi post for the drop.

morning: Drop day. Listings go live. Send your email/Ko-fi announcement.
evening: Engage with everyone who comments or shares.
content: Drop day post — your best content yet.
win: You launched a drop. That's a real business move.

morning: Thank anyone who bought. Respond to every comment from drop day.
evening: Sketch ideas for the next drop — keep the momentum.
win: You showed up the day after. That's rare.

morning: Plan your YouTube debut video — topic, structure, what you'd show.
evening: Write a loose script or bullet points for the video.

morning: Set up your YouTube channel — name, banner, description.
evening: Film your first YouTube video. Done > perfect.

morning: Edit your YouTube video (basic — you don't need to be perfect).
evening: Upload and schedule it.
content: Post about your YouTube launch — 'new video dropping.'

morning: Your YouTube video goes live. Share everywhere.
evening: Batch: design 3 new stickers for the next drop.
content: Pin your YouTube link everywhere. Announce it.

morning: Phase 2 review. Read back your Phase 1 reflection. How far have you come?
evening: Celebrate Phase 2. List 5 real things you built.
content: Post a Phase 2 wrap-up. It'll mean something later.
win: Phase 2 complete. You have a real business.

morning: Phase 3 begins. Write your Phase 3 goal: what does 'done' look like at Day 90?
evening: Map out your next drop concept — bigger than the last.

morning: Design new collection piece #1.
evening: Design new collection piece #2.

morning: Design #3 of collection.
evening: Design #4 of collection.

morning: Day 60 letter unlocked. Read it when you open the app.
evening: Reflect: which part of your business feels most alive right now?

morning: Design #5 of collection. Finish it.
evening: Export all 5. Assemble mock collection sheet.

morning: Batch: all mockups for the collection drop.
evening: Batch film content for next 2 weeks.
content: Post collection announcement — go bigger this time.
win: Drop is prepped and content is ahead.

morning: Rest. Read something that inspires you.
evening: Quick week 10 plan.

morning: Drop day. Launch collection.
evening: Engage with everyone who interacts.
content: Drop day content — your most polished yet.

morning: Post-drop: respond to every comment, message, share.
evening: Write a post-drop reflection in your journal.

morning: Plan a community-first post — ask your followers a question.
evening: Engage with all responses. Build the feeling of a community.
content: Ask your audience a question. Engage genuinely.

morning: Work on YouTube video #2 — topic, script.
evening: Film it.

morning: Edit YouTube video #2.
evening: Upload and schedule it.

morning: Batch: design 4 new stickers.
evening: Export and list at least 2.
content: Post a batch day vlog or timelapse.

morning: 10 more days of designs. Plan a final push for listings.
evening: Plan the final 20 days of Phase 3.
win: You can see the finish line.

morning: Design and list 2 new stickers.
evening: Update your best-selling listing's photos.

morning: Write your 'big sis energy' origin story post — longer form.
evening: Turn it into a caption or blog post.
content: Post your origin story. This one matters.

morning: Design 2 new pieces.
evening: Create mockups and list them.

morning: Set up a Discord or Ko-fi community tier.
evening: Write a welcome message and pinned intro post.

morning: Design 2 more new pieces.
evening: List and describe them well.

morning: Batch: plan final drop of Phase 3 — your most cohesive collection.
evening: Sketch all 5 pieces of final drop.

morning: Rest. You're in the final stretch — protect your energy.
evening: Week 12 plan. What has to be done before Day 90?

morning: Design final drop piece #1.
evening: Design final drop piece #2.

morning: Design final drop pieces #3 and #4.
evening: Design final drop piece #5.

morning: Create mockups for all final drop pieces.
evening: Schedule all final drop listings.
content: Big build-up content post — '5 days until the final drop.'
win: You're doing a final drop. Real business stuff.

morning: Film YouTube video #3 — make it about this journey.
evening: Edit it.

morning: Upload YouTube video #3.
evening: Write your Day 90 letter to yourself — save it for the app.

morning: Final drop day. All listings go live. Send your announcement.
evening: Engage with every single interaction.
content: Final drop content. Your most ambitious post.

morning: Rest after the drop. You launched 4 collections in 90 days.
evening: Write a reflection: who are you now vs Day 1?

morning: Review your full shop. Are you proud of it?
evening: Update your bio, banner, and any listings that feel off.

morning: Write a letter to the person who finds your shop today.
evening: Turn it into an 'about' page or pinned post.
content: Post your letter to future customers.

morning: Spend your morning block purely drawing for joy — no business goal.
evening: Share whatever you made, just because you made it.
content: Share something just because it's yours.

morning: Write your 3 goals for beyond Day 90.
evening: Share them somewhere — journal, Ko-fi, a post.

morning: Do a final full shop audit. Photos, prices, SEO, everything.
evening: Fix anything that's been bugging you.
win: Shop is ready for the world.

morning: Day 90. You made it. Open the app and read your Day 90 letter.
evening: Celebrate — whatever that looks like for you. You built a real thing.
content: Day 90 post. Tell your whole story. It matters.
win: Day 90. Crown badge. Artisan. You did it.
